test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A hollow spherical vessel has external and internal radii of 10.5 cm and 7.7 cm respectively. What is the mass (in kg, rounded off to the nearest tens) of the sphere if it is made of metal of density 10.3 g/cm³? (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

External radius (Rₑₓₜ) = 10.5 cm

Internal radius (Rᵢₙₜ) = 7.7 cm

Density of the metal (ρ) = 10.3 g/cm³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4)/(3) pi r³ 

Volume of the hollow sphere = Volume of external sphere - Volume of internal sphere

Mass = Density × Volume

**Calculation:**

Volume of external sphere (Vₑₓₜ)

⇒ Vₑₓₜ = (4)/(3) pi (10.5)³

⇒ Vₑₓₜ = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 1157.625 

⇒ Vₑₓₜ = 4852.5 cm³

Volume of internal sphere (Vᵢₙₜ)

⇒ Vᵢₙₜ = (4)/(3) pi (7.7)³

⇒ Vᵢₙₜ = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 456.533 

⇒ Vᵢₙₜ = 1980 cm³

Volume of the hollow sphere (V)

⇒ V = Vₑₓₜ - Vᵢₙₜ

⇒ V = 4852.5 - 1980

⇒ V = 2872.5 cm³

Mass (m)

⇒ m = ρ × V

⇒ m = 10.3 × 2872.5

⇒ m = 29587.75 g

Convert g to kg

⇒ m = 29587.75 / 1000

⇒ m ≈ 29.6 kg

Rounded off to the nearest tens, mass = 30 kg

**The mass of the sphere is 30 kg.**
